sentences.en: We are popping into your feeds today to give you a special top-of-the-year

sentences.en: Network.

sentences.en: It is a podcast called The Lazy Genius with Kendra Adachi.
sentences.zh: 它是一档名为《懒人天才》（The Lazy Genius），由肯德拉·阿达奇（Kendra Adachi）主持的播客。

sentences.en: We are so thrilled to have Kendra join the Office Ladies Network.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴肯德拉能加入《办公室女士》网络。

sentences.en: We wanted to share with you an
sentences.zh: 我们想和大家分享一段

sentences.en: excerpt from her podcaSt. This week's episode is called Starting Fresh When You Can't Start Over.
sentences.zh: 她播客的节选。本周的节目主题是“无法从头开始时，如何重新出发”。

sentences.en: We hope that you'll give it a listen and love it as much as we do.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能去听一听，并像我们一样喜欢它。

sentences.en: I think we need a fresh take on January energy.
sentences.zh: 我想我们需要对一月份的能量有种全新的理解。

sentences.en: We need some new words when we feel this compulsion
sentences.zh: 当我们感到那种想要

sentences.en: to start over.
sentences.zh: 从头开始的冲动时，我们需要一些新的词汇。

sentences.en: I shared some of these words last January, actually, and I need the reminder
sentences.zh: 其实去年一月我就分享过其中一些词，而我自己也同样

sentences.en: just as much as anyone.
sentences.zh: 需要这些提醒。

sentences.en: So we're going to look at those words again.
sentences.zh: 所以我们打算再次审视这些词汇。

sentences.en: The first word that will help us start fresh instead of starting over is continue.
sentences.zh: 第一个能帮助我们“重新出发”而不是“从头开始”的词是：继续（continue）。

sentences.en: Continue.
sentences.zh: 继续。

sentences.en: Instead of beginning, continue.
sentences.zh: 不要重新开始，而是继续。

sentences.en: Everything you do builds on what has come before.
sentences.zh: 你所做的一切都是建立在过去的基础之上的。

sentences.en: You're living a beautiful, sometimes messy life, and it's a continuation.
sentences.zh: 你正在过着一种美好但有时又有些混乱的生活，这是一种延续。

sentences.en: January does not have to
sentences.zh: 一月并不一定非要

sentences.en: be a restart.
sentences.zh: 是一个重启点。

sentences.en: It is not necessarily a new beginning.
sentences.zh: 它不一定非得是一个新的开始。

sentences.en: Now, energetically, there are some really helpful
sentences.zh: 当然，从能量上讲，一月份的那种感觉，即日历翻开新的一页，确实有一些

sentences.en: things about those feelings of January, of the literal turning of the calendar, but that does not
sentences.zh: 非常有益的地方，但这并不

sentences.en: require you to begin everything anew.
sentences.zh: 要求你把一切都推倒重来。

sentences.en: In fact, you can't.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你做不到。

sentences.en: That takes so much work.
sentences.zh: 那需要耗费太多的精力。

sentences.en: Instead, if you feel
sentences.zh: 相反，如果你感到

sentences.en: the pressure to begin something that does not truly align with what matters to you, simply continue.
sentences.zh: 压力，觉得必须开始做一些并不真正符合你价值观的事情，那就简单地继续下去。

sentences.en: Continue doing what you're doing, knowing that you're not failing anything by not starting over,
sentences.zh: 继续做你正在做的事情，要知道，没有“从头开始”，没有

sentences.en: by not beginning again, just because it's January.
sentences.zh: “重新开始”，并不代表你失败了，仅仅因为现在是一月而已。

sentences.en: Continue.
sentences.zh: 继续。

sentences.en: You're really smart.
sentences.zh: 你真的很聪明。

sentences.en: You're probably
sentences.zh: 你可能

sentences.en: already doing a lot of great things that don't need a reset.
sentences.zh: 已经在做很多很棒的事情，它们根本不需要重置。

sentences.en: They don't even need tinkering with.
sentences.zh: 甚至连修补都不需要。

sentences.en: Just continue.
sentences.zh: 只需继续。

sentences.en: And the places that you know what matters and you know what works most of the time,
sentences.zh: 而在那些你知道什么才是重要的、知道什么在大多数时候是行之有效的地方，

sentences.en: continue.
sentences.zh: 继续下去。

sentences.en: The second word is tend.
sentences.zh: 第二个词是：照料（tend）。

sentences.en: Don't fix.
sentences.zh: 不要去修复。

sentences.en: Tend.
sentences.zh: 要去呵护。

sentences.en: Now, don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: 现在，别误会我的意思。

sentences.en: There are things that
sentences.zh: 有些事情确实

sentences.en: need fixing.
sentences.zh: 需要修复。

sentences.en: They need to be taken apart and put back together.
sentences.zh: 它们需要被拆解，然后再重新组装。

sentences.en: But usually that stuff like
sentences.zh: 但通常像

sentences.en: toilets or an Ikea closet that was not installed correctly, we fix things.
sentences.zh: 马桶或者没装好的宜家衣柜这类东西，我们确实会去修复。

sentences.en: We can't exactly fix life,
sentences.zh: 我们无法真正修复生活，

sentences.en: but we sure do try, don't we?
sentences.zh: 但我们确实在努力，不是吗？

sentences.en: We come at it like a certain part of our life is a problem to solve
sentences.zh: 我们总是觉得生活的某一部分是个需要解决的问题，

sentences.en: and to fix when really most of our lives need nurturing and tending.
sentences.zh: 需要去修复，但实际上，我们的大部分生活更需要的是滋养和呵护。

sentences.en: They need compassion alongside
sentences.zh: 它们在需要纠正的同时，

sentences.en: correcting.
sentences.zh: 也需要同情心。

sentences.en: And when we compassionately correct one small thing at a time, that is tending.
sentences.zh: 当我们带着同情心一次只纠正一件小事时，这就是呵护。

sentences.en: That's
sentences.zh: 这就是

sentences.en: looking at what's there with kind eyes, not going too fast and taking it one step at a time.
sentences.zh: 用善意的眼光审视现状，不要操之过急，一步一个脚印。

sentences.en: That
sentences.zh: 这

sentences.en: is so much more sustainable than continuously taking apart and putting back together all the systems and
sentences.zh: 比不断地拆解和重组你生活中的所有系统、

sentences.en: processes and goals of your life.
sentences.zh: 流程和目标要可持续得多。

sentences.en: So think about where you feel the need to fix.
sentences.zh: 所以，想一想你在哪里感到需要“修复”。

sentences.en: And if instead you need
sentences.zh: 如果相反，你需要的是

sentences.en: to tend, the third word is small.
sentences.zh: “呵护”，那么第三个词就是“小”。

sentences.en: I love small things.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢小事物。

sentences.en: I love small choices, small differences,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢小的选择、小的改变、

sentences.en: small steps, small probleMs. That's why one of the 13 Lazy Genius principles is to start small.
sentences.zh: 小的步骤、小的问题。这就是为什么“懒人天才”的13条原则之一就是从小事做起。

sentences.en: The smaller something is, the easier it is to solve, to tend to, to manage, to live with,
sentences.zh: 事情越小，就越容易解决、呵护、管理、共处，

sentences.en: to incorporate into your life on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 也越容易融入你的日常生活。

sentences.en: But January energy is big energy, right?
sentences.zh: 但一月份的能量总是很大，对吧？

sentences.en: It's big
sentences.zh: 那是大

sentences.en: swings, big systems, big changes.
sentences.zh: 动作、大系统、大变革。

sentences.en: And that's why we can't stick with anything.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们什么都坚持不下去。

sentences.en: We're starting with big
sentences.zh: 我们从大

sentences.en: problems and big problems require big solutions.
sentences.zh: 问题入手，而大问题需要大方案。

sentences.en: I don't know about you, but I don't have room for
sentences.zh: 我不了解你，但我现在没有空间

sentences.en: big solutions right now.
sentences.zh: 去处理大方案。

sentences.en: Life is beautifully unwieldy and inviting big systems or big goals or big solutions
sentences.zh: 生活是美妙而难以驾驭的，引入大系统、大目标或大方案

sentences.en: into that is almost impossible.
sentences.zh: 几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: And when those big things don't work and they won't, I want to start
sentences.zh: 当那些大动作行不通时——它们确实行不通——我就想

sentences.en: over.
sentences.zh: 重来。

sentences.en: I want to call them all again and get to try again so that what came before wasn't a failure.
sentences.zh: 我想把它们全部推倒重来，这样之前的努力就不算失败。

sentences.en: Instead, let's start small, like really, really embarrassingly small.
sentences.zh: 相反，让我们从小事做起，那种真的、真的小到让人尴尬的小事。

sentences.en: I told a story in my first
sentences.zh: 我在我的第一本书

sentences.en: book, The Lazy Genius Way, about how I started small with yoga.
sentences.zh: 《懒人天才之道》里讲过一个故事，关于我是如何从小事开始练习瑜伽的。

sentences.en: I have terrible joints as well as
sentences.zh: 我的关节很糟糕，而且

sentences.en: like a lot of frantic mental energy.
sentences.zh: 还有很多狂躁的心理能量。

sentences.en: I call myself a caffeinated squirrel.
sentences.zh: 我称自己为“咖啡因松鼠”。

sentences.en: And consequently, being a
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一个

sentences.en: caffeinated squirrel with hips and knees that are basically made of glass, yoga is really good for
sentences.zh: 有着几乎像玻璃一样脆弱的髋关节和膝关节的“咖啡因松鼠”，瑜伽对我来说

sentences.en: me.
sentences.zh: 真的很有益。

sentences.en: It's good for my joints and for my brain.
sentences.zh: 这对我的关节和大脑都有好处。

sentences.en: Well, years and years ago, I knew this and tried to
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多年前，我就知道这一点，并尝试过

sentences.en: incorporate more yoga into my life, but I could not make it work.
sentences.zh: 把瑜伽更多地融入我的生活，但我没能坚持下来。

sentences.en: I couldn't get it to stick.
sentences.zh: 我没法让它成为习惯。

sentences.en: And I got so
sentences.zh: 我为此感到

sentences.en: frustrated by that because it mattered to me.
sentences.zh: 非常沮丧，因为它对我来说很重要。

sentences.en: Like it, it, yoga mattered to me for reasons that felt right
sentences.zh: 就像，瑜伽对我来说很重要，原因在于它感觉是对的，

sentences.en: and good and aligned with tending to my body.
sentences.zh: 是好的，并且符合我照顾身体的需求。

sentences.en: But I just couldn't seem to get into a rhythm at all.
sentences.zh: 但我似乎根本无法找到节奏。

sentences.en: And you know what I did?
sentences.zh: 你知道我做了什么吗？

sentences.en: I just kept restarting.
sentences.zh: 我只是不断地重新开始。

sentences.en: I kept restarting the commitment counter to zero
sentences.zh: 我不断地把承诺计数器归零，

sentences.en: over and over again.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次。

sentences.en: And that was also defeating.
sentences.zh: 那也让人感到挫败。

sentences.en: So I tried, I tried a new approach.
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试了一种新方法。

sentences.en: I made doing yoga
sentences.zh: 我把做瑜伽这件事

sentences.en: embarrassingly small.
sentences.zh: 缩小到令人尴尬的地步。

sentences.zh: 我说我每天要做一个下犬式。

sentences.en: One down dog a day.
sentences.zh: 每天一个下犬式。

sentences.en: If you're
sentences.zh: 如果你

sentences.en: unfamiliar with yoga, that's basically like bending over once a day and sticking your butt in the air.
sentences.zh: 不熟悉瑜伽，这基本上就像每天弯腰一次，把屁股撅在空中。

sentences.en: Some might argue that's not even yoga, but it was so small, but I did it.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会说这甚至算不上瑜伽，但它太简单了，所以我做到了。

sentences.zh: 我做到了这件

sentences.en: mattered to me.

sentences.en: And hear me,

sentences.en: salutation, which still only takes like 60 seconds, but I didn't change what the daily habit was

sentences.en: of one down dog a day for literal months.

sentences.en: It was so small
sentences.zh: 它太小了，

sentences.en: that it became part of my life and my routine in a way that worked in a way that supported what

sentences.en: I just love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。
